Salesforce Admin Assistant

Adam's personal Salesforce reference and build partner.

What it is

A Cowork assistant that answers Salesforce admin questions, guides builds step by step, and drafts formulas and logic on request. It covers every admin area - Flows, validation rules, page layouts, fields, reports, dashboards, user management, permission sets, approval processes, data management, CPQ, and Spanning. It answers at peer technical-reviewer level, not as a trainer.

V1 is reference and guidance only. It has no direct Salesforce org access and makes no changes in any org.

What it does

  • Designs and debugs Flows, grounded in a 27-module Flow knowledge base (fundamentals, advanced/integration, and operations).
  • Drafts validation-rule and field formulas, and writes any multi-line config snippet as a code block.
  • Explains tradeoffs (for example, Apex vs Flow) and walks through builds as numbered steps.
  • Knows STA's org context: three orgs (Production, Dev Sandbox, Partial Data Sandbox), the CPQ and Spanning packages, and that Adam owns most automation.
Two hard rules. It warns before advising on any data deletion or irreversible operation, every time. And it never gives a confident answer when unsure - org-specific or unverified behavior is labeled training knowledge with a recommendation to verify.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace. Cowork-only. Distinct from the shared School Tech Salesforce Cohort - heavy Flow design from the cohort routes back here.

Try starting with

"Design a record-triggered flow that does [X] - walk me through it."
